newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Alestra offers phone discount to business.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Alestra offers phone discount to business.

text.p: Alestra, the Mexican long-distance telephone company that is partly owned by AT&T, on Thursday began offering six-monthly discounts to business clients.
It said it would offer existing and future clients on the sixth month a discount in their bill equivalent to eight percent of their accumulated net consumption in the previous five months.
On the 12th month of the year, it would give the same discount for the total consumption in the seventh to 11th months.
A price war has begun between the major telephone companies who are competing for a slice of the long-distance market that until this year was operated exclusively by Telefonos de Mexico .
